rv.q: In its visual presentation, then, Den Hertog’s staging captures something of life in north-east Scotland as it was drawn by Lewis Grassic Gibbon in his 1932 novel (published three years before his death at the age of 33). In other respects, both the production and Morna Young’s new adaptation are less satisfying.
With directon from Finn den Hertog, this is a visually stunning adaptation of Lewis Grassic Gibbon’s classic novel
